title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Survey Instrument. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Survey Instrument
options.lineage: surveyor's total station readouts and calibration bench panels
options.thesis: The calculator presented as a calibrated field instrument: one bench, engraved labels, inset LCD readouts, numerals that lock to a grid — precision you can audit at a glance, not another spreadsheet.
options.viewport: A warm light bench: instrument-bezel top bar with the project name as an ID plate; a settings plate for precision/confidence/plot size; the strata ledger as the dominant readout table in tabular mono; headline results (n total, per-stratum plots) as inset LCD windows with exact-length allocation bars.
options.risk: Restraint is the risk: if the panel language is applied timidly it collapses into generic gray UI, so the commitment to instrument chrome (ID plates, readout insets, engraved tracked labels) must be total.

raised.raise: Row and field state is carried in line form — weight, dash, strike — never in hue alone.
Allocation bars are drawn to exact proportion: the bar's length IS the plot count.
On recompute, every number settles into place once — values land, they never flicker.
Document state is a named phase (Draft / Valid / Excluded), labeled in words, color only secondary.
Registration discipline: every numeral locks to a shared column grid, tight to the edge, nothing floats.
The headline n reads as a live instrument readout, set apart from the furniture.

options.label: The Field Tally Book
options.lineage: waterproof surveyor's tally notebooks and plot data sheets
options.thesis: The calculation as a page in the surveyor's waterproof book: gridded paper, pencil-entry columns, hand-ruled totals — the artifact this tool replaces, honored as an interface.
options.viewport: A notebook spread: strata as ruled data rows in mono pencil, the running total as a hand-ruled sum line, results boxed in the margin like a field check.
options.risk: Notebook metaphors are familiar territory — the most grounded and safest direction on the table, and the direction most runs in this category land on.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.lineage: glass spectrograms on a charcoal continuum
options.thesis: Every element hangs off one off-centre calibrated rail; color exists only as hairline emission lines; state is line height, dash, and doubling.
options.viewport: One rail across the page; the open stratum blooms into a plate, the rest are hairline stubs.
options.case: Fuses well — carbon labs live in spectrometry — but the rail topology fights dense per-stratum table scanning, the calculator's core task.
options.risk: Spectacle over scanability; a table this dense cannot hang off one rail.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.lineage: dance notation scores where symbol length is exact duration
options.thesis: A score where every mark's length is its exact quantity and shading is its level — notation where the geometry is the data.
options.viewport: A ruled score: strata as columns of blocks whose lengths are their plot counts, the beat band marking the active estimate.
options.case: Length-is-quantity is exactly what allocation needs; loses narrowly on audience identification — MRV professionals read ledgers, not dance scores.
options.risk: Alien notation for a conservative audience; the grammar must be learned before it can be trusted.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.lineage: green-phosphor terminals in midnight machine rooms
options.case: Fuses poorly: glowing dark glass is unreadable for all-day tabular audit work beside Excel, and the audience identifies with instruments, not terminals.
options.kept: The live readout register: the headline n is set apart as an instrument reading.

options.label: Gravity-Rain Garden
options.lineage: surreal gardens where rain falls in colored gravities
options.case: Fuses poorly: surreal play has no identification with MRV professionals and buries the numbers it should serve.
options.kept: Deterministic settling: computed values land once, in place, like drops finding their level.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: theater cycloramas passing from black night through cobalt and rose into day
options.case: Fuses poorly: atmosphere is expression the task does not need, and light-band navigation hides the ledger.
options.kept: Named phases: document state (Draft / Valid / Excluded) is a labeled phase, never color alone.

options.label: TDR Info-Noise Sleeve
options.case: Fuses poorly: information noise is the exact opposite of the auditability this product sells.
options.kept: Registration discipline: every numeral locks tight to a shared column grid.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The clean shadcn tool UI this category always ships — neutral chrome, blue accent, tidy card grid — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects from a calculator tool, polished to the last pixel.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from a thousand other internal tools — which is precisely why the incumbent was called ugly.
